title: sverify_contract: the OpenLineage dataset facet of a node's contract
description: The custom dataset facet sverify adds to the output of each refreshed node in its OpenLineage events (sverify.openlineage, #792): the node's contract, each postcondition's status, the route and class, quarantined rows, and the verified plan exported to Substrait, from which a downstream job proves the contract again. Format 1. Within 1.x the format only gains optional keys, and readers ignore keys they do not know (docs/stability.md). Keys reuse the report JSON's names (report.schema.json).

sverify.description: The version of sverify that wrote the facet.

node.description: The node's name: the job's name.

plan.description: sha256 of the plan as Lean wrote it, in hex, as the sink's contract record has it.

proved.description: Whether the checker proved every postcondition.

semantics.description: The semantics the plan was verified under.

equivalence.description: What the postconditions observe, as sv.equivalent prints it.

requires.description: The preconditions, by input table, as labels.

label.description: The condition as the transform states it.

status.description: proved by the checker, checked on the data at every refresh, or not_proved. 1.x may add values.

sql.description: A row condition as SQL over the output's columns.

unique.description: A key: the columns no two rows share.

not_null.description: Columns the report shows never NULL.

route.description: How the proof reached the engine on this refresh, as in the report JSON's routes.

outcome.description: ok, quarantined or held, as Refresh.to_json says.

quarantined.description: Rows of the node's sources quarantined after the refresh, in all.

held.description: Why the node did not take the batch.

substrait.description: The verified plan exported to Substrait (Report.to_substrait, protobuf JSON), which sv.from_substrait proves again. Absent where the plan has no export.
